description: Married beneficiary filing separately who lived with the spouse during the year, MAGI 120,000: the separate table jumps straight to its second row.
worked:
Premium year 2025; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2023 tax return (two years back): 120,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2025 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the table for beneficiaries who are married and lived with their spouses at any time during the year but file separate tax returns: 120,000 is greater than 106,000 and less than 394,000.
Part B: standard premium 185.00 + income-related adjustment 406.90 = total monthly premium 591.90.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 78.60 (added to the plan premium).
